title: Is "sampler" your word for the 50 g pouches?
why: This week we name the product groups that every report and ad will use. You said the word once in passing, and a wrong word would be repeated everywhere.

evidence.quote: The little 50 gram pouches, we call those samplers. The 250 gram tins are what people come back for.

evidence.label: Products in this group
evidence.value: 6 flavours, all sold as 50 g pouches

recommend.because: It is your own word from your own meeting, and it keeps them apart from the 250 g tins.

if_no: We keep calling them "50 g pouches" and ask you which word you would rather use.
